Name: Epaphras
Summary: Epaphras was a faithful minister and servant of Christ from Colossae who taught the Colossians, laboured fervently for them in prayer, and was Paul's fellowprisoner when Philemon was written.
KeyStory: Epaphras was a faithful minister and servant of Christ from Colossae who taught the Colossians, laboured fervently for them in prayer, and was Paul's fellowprisoner when Philemon was written.
LifeLesson: Fervent prayer for others, unseen, is labour as real as any journey.
